scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @mmm/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @mmm/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @mmm/api && npm run build --workspace @mmm/web
scripts.lint: eslint server packages scripts *.mjs --max-warnings 0 && npm run lint --workspace @mmm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
